cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader, is near the city of Jericho when he looks up. A man is standing right in front of him, holding a drawn sword. Me? I'd have hopped my gold base straight back to the bakery.

cards.question: Joshua doesn't run. He walks right up to the man with the sword. What does Joshua ask Him?

answers.text: Are You for us or for our enemies
Have You come out from Jericho
What is Your name and Your people

cards.question: When Joshua asks whose side He's on, the man with the sword says He's on Israel's side.
The man with the sword says, “Neither,” and then tells Joshua who He is. Who does He say He is?

cards.text: Joshua hits the ground facedown in reverence. Then he asks, “What does my Lord have to say to His servant?”

cards.question: The Commander of the LORD's army tells Joshua the place where he's standing is holy. So what does He tell Joshua to do?

cards.text: And Joshua does it, right there. Now, friend, take a look at the city.

cards.question: With the Israelites close by, Jericho keeps its gates open, and people come and go like normal.

cards.text: No one goes out and no one comes in, so Jericho is shut up tighter than the junk drawer I spent all those years in. Then the LORD speaks to Joshua.

cards.question: Before anybody marches anywhere, the LORD tells Joshua He has delivered Jericho into Joshua's hand.

cards.text: The city, its king and its mighty men of valor, all of it in Joshua's hand. And then comes the battle plan.

cards.question: Step one of the LORD's plan: all the men of war circle Jericho ___ a day, for six days.

cards.text: And there's a job for the priests: seven of them carry seven rams' horns, walking in front of the ark.

cards.question: Six days of marching, one lap around Jericho a day. What's different on the seventh day?

answers.text: They circle the city seven times
They camp and wait at the gates

cards.question: Then the LORD says that at a long blast of the ram's horn, the people are to give a mighty ___, and the city's ___ will collapse.

cards.text: And then, the LORD says, all the people will charge straight into the city. No ladders. No battering rams. Just horns, marching and one BIG shout.
So Joshua son of Nun calls the priests and passes the plan along. Out they go, seven priests blowing seven rams' horns, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD following them.

cards.question: Armed troops march out front, then the priests with their horns, then the ark. Who marches behind the ark?

cards.text: But Joshua gave the people one more order. And friend, this one would've been the hardest one for me.

cards.question: The horns keep sounding as they march. What's Joshua's order for the people?

answers.text: Not one word until he says shout
Sing praises the whole way around
Call on the city to surrender

cards.question: After circling Jericho once, the people head back to the camp and spend the night there.

cards.text: The next morning, Joshua is up early, and the priests take up the ark of the LORD again.

cards.question: On the second day, the priests stop blowing the horns so the march around Jericho is totally silent.

cards.text: Horns sounding, one lap, back to camp. Six days of that, and by day four I'd be the guy silently tapping everybody's shoulder and pointing at the wall.

cards.question: On the seventh day, they get up at ___ and march around Jericho seven times.

cards.text: That's the only day they circle the city seven times. Seven laps, friend, and still not one word from the people.
After the seventh lap, the priests blow the horns, and Joshua commands the people, “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!”
Joshua isn't done talking yet. The city and everything in it must be devoted to the LORD for destruction, except for one house.

cards.question: Only one household in Jericho will live. Whose?

answers.text: Rahab and all those with her
Tamar and all those with her
Deborah and all those with her

cards.question: Joshua says Rahab the prostitute gets spared because she ___ the spies Israel sent.

cards.text: Then a warning. Keep away from the things devoted to destruction, because taking any of them will bring disaster on the camp of Israel.

cards.question: Joshua tells the people they can keep any silver and gold they find in Jericho.

cards.text: Every bit of the silver, gold, bronze and iron is holy to the LORD and must go into His treasury. Then the horns sound, the people give a great shout, and the wall COLLAPSES.
All the people charge straight into the city and capture it. With the edge of the sword, they devote to destruction everything in the city: man and woman, young and old, oxen, sheep and donkeys.

cards.question: Joshua sends someone into Rahab's house to bring her out. Who does he send?

answers.text: The two men who spied out the land
The seven priests with the horns
The rear guard behind the ark

cards.text: Just as they promised, the spies bring out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and her whole family. That's a promise KEPT, friend, and I can't even keep my promise to taste only one cookie off the tray each morning.

cards.question: The spies settle Rahab's family inside the camp of Israel.

cards.text: Then the Israelites burn the city and everything in it. But the silver, gold, bronze and iron go into the treasury of the LORD's house.

cards.question: Joshua spares Rahab and her family. When this was written, she was still living among the ___.

cards.text: Then Joshua makes a solemn oath about Jericho, and it's about whoever would try to build it again.

cards.question: What does Joshua's oath say about the man who rises up and rebuilds Jericho?

answers.text: He is cursed before the LORD
He is blessed with a great name
He will rule over all the land

cards.question: Joshua's oath says the man who rebuilds Jericho will lay its foundations at the cost of his firstborn.
Joshua's fame spreads throughout the land.

cards.text: So the LORD is with Joshua, and that's where we'll leave Jericho for now. Hang on to your apron, friend, because Israel's story in this land isn't done.
